name: @pipeworx/mcp-intercom

tools.name: ic_search_contacts
tools.description: Search for contacts by name, email, or custom attributes. Returns contact ID, name, email, and metadata.

query.description: Search by email, name, or other field

tools.name: ic_get_contact
tools.description: Get full contact details by ID. Returns name, email, phone, attributes, tags, and conversation history.

tools.name: ic_list_conversations
tools.description: List conversations with pagination. Returns conversation ID, participants, status, created date, and last message preview.

tools.name: ic_get_conversation
tools.description: Get complete conversation thread by ID. Returns all messages, timestamps, participants, and metadata.

tools.name: ic_list_companies
tools.description: List companies with pagination. Returns company ID, name, website, employee count, and custom attributes.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-intercom forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the intercom pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
